The Programme

Learn it in the morning.
Play it in the afternoon.

Pascal's coaching follows a single principle: one focused theme per day. Two hours of structured technical work in the morning — video analysis, data capture, clear takeaways. That afternoon, 18 holes on a championship course applying exactly what you learned. The feedback loop between lesson and real course is what makes improvement tangible within the week.

Just 90 minutes from Calais, the Côte d'Opale is one of Europe's finest and least discovered golf destinations. Pine forest, wild dune links and classic heathland — four entirely different tests of golf, all within minutes of each other.

This is a small, exclusive group. Fourteen guests maximum. Real individual attention from Pascal, dinners that feel like a private gathering, and a group small enough that everyone knows each other by day two.

Four Championship Courses

Four entirely different
tests of golf

Day 1 · Sunday 13 September
La Forêt
Le Touquet · Heathland Classic
A superb opener. Le Touquet's classic heathland layout — find your rhythm with Pascal on hand throughout every hole.
Day 2 · Monday 14 September
Golf de Belle Dune
Fort-Mahon · Dune Links · Jean-Manuel Rossi, 1992
Spectacular dune links carved through a protected nature reserve. Wild terrain, ocean air, and a course that surprises every golfer who plays it.
Day 3 · Tuesday 15 September
Golf d'Hardelot — Les Pins
Hardelot · Tom Simpson · Top 30 Continental Europe
The jewel of the Côte d'Opale. Tom Simpson's pine-framed masterpiece — deep bunkers, immaculate condition, one of France's most beautiful golf settings.
Day 4 · Wednesday 16 September · Farewell Round
La Mer — Le Touquet
Harry Colt, 1931 · Six-time French Open Host
The perfect finale. A Harry Colt masterpiece. Celebrate in style at La Mer's exceptional clubhouse before the journey home via Calais Vins.
